name: cuelume
description: Two cuelume sounds for Claude Code: ready when a long turn ends, attention when a permission prompt waits.

readyEnabled.title: Turn-end cue
readyEnabled.description: Play the ready cue when a long turn ends with an answer.

attentionEnabled.title: Permission cue
attentionEnabled.description: Play the attention cue when a permission prompt is waiting.

minSeconds.title: Ring after (seconds)
minSeconds.description: Only play the ready cue for turns that ran at least this long.

gain.title: Volume (gain)
gain.description: Playback gain applied to the bundled sounds (0.1 to 3).
